newsitem.title: USA: US Senate to vote on Barshefsky next week -- Daschle.
newsitem.headline: US Senate to vote on Barshefsky next week -- Daschle.

text.p: The Senate will vote on the nomination of Charlene Barshefsky to be U.S Trade Representative next week, Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle said Friday.

Daschle told reporters after meeting President Clinton at the White House: "I was able to report to the President that Charlene Barshefsky's nomination will come up next week, we hope as early as Tuesday or Wednesday."
But he said there was no progress to report on other nominations still pending.
